plan.title: Edit Evaluation Time Offered on Live RFQ

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with two vendor bids on its summary page.
Enable the required eRFX project configuration before accessing the prepared RFQ.
Assert that the RFQ Settings menu offers Edit Evaluation Time and that it is clickable.
Select the enabled menu item to open its evaluation-time dialog.
Verify that clicking the menu item opens the Edit Evaluation Time window.
Cancel the dialog so no evaluation-time change is confirmed.
Verify that the dialog closed after cancellation.
